title: Chapter 527 - 527 Award-Winning; Trending Searches! (2)
content:
Chapter 527 - 527 Award-Winning; Trending Searches! (2)

Chapter 527 - 527 Award-Winning; Trending Searches! (2)

527 Award-Winning; Trending Searches! (2)

He looked even happier than if he had won the Nobel Prize.

While everyone was excited, Lin Fan’s phone rang again.

It was an unfamiliar foreign number once again.

Just like before, Lin Fan chose to pick up the call.

“Hello, Professor Lin Fan. I’m Choba, the chairman of the Nobel Committee for medicine.” A slightly hoarse voice sounded from the other end.

When Lin Fan heard this, a strange look appeared on his face.

The president of the Nobel Committee for medicine?

“Hello.”

“Today, the Nobel Committee for Medicine conducted a rigorous selection and finally elected you as the winner of this year’s Nobel Prize in medicine. Congratulations.”

“Alright.” When Lin Fan received the call, he had already expected it, so he answered even faster.

After hanging up the phone, Lin Fan saw Hao Zhiwu and the others looking at him questioningly.

“It’s a call from the president of the Nobel Committee for medicine. He told me that I won the Nobel Prize in medicine.”

Hao Zhiwu immediately jumped up.

“As expected! I told you that Professor Lin would definitely win the Nobel Prize in medicine, right?! After all, Professor Lin invented the human islet recovery drug! How big of an achievement is this?”

The other people in the office were still a little stunned.

After hearing Hao Zhiwu’s words, they also shouted excitedly.

“Three! Three Nobel Prizes!”

“Heavens!”

“Professor Lin, you’re too amazing!”

“I feel like I’m dreaming…”

“There was a long debate on the internet about which Nobel Prize Professor Lin would win. Who would have thought that Professor Lin would win the Nobel Prize in physics, chemistry, and medicine at the same time?”

“No! Xia Bing and Xia Xue thought of it!”

When they mentioned this, they could not help but focus their eyes on Xia Bing and Xia Xue.

In the past, if Xia Bing and Xia Xue were stared at by so many people, they would definitely be so shy that they wanted to bury their heads.

Now, they raised their heads and looked at Lin Fan with their beautiful eyes. Their faces were filled with smiles and blessings.

Lin Fan… won three Nobel Prizes!

In the eyes of Xia Bing and Xia Xue, Lin Fan’s body was emitting a dazzling light. His entire person seemed to have transformed into a fiery red sun, extremely dazzling!

At this moment, Lin Fan’s phone rang again.

This time, there was no exception. It was also a foreign number.

Lin Fan had already received three overseas calls. Now that he received another one, he seemed to have gotten used to it and immediately pressed the answer button.

“Hello, are you Professor Lin Fan?” A burst of fluent English sounded on the phone.

Lin Fan said in Chinese, “It’s me.”

After a while, a magnetic voice came from the phone again.

“Professor Lin, how are you? I’m the assistant of Mr. Marko, the chairman of the Nobel Peace Prize Committee. Mr. Marko said that after a vote by all the members of the Nobel Peace Committee, you’ve been decided as the winner of this year’s Nobel Peace Prize…”

After the Nobel Prize in chemistry, the Nobel Prize in physics, and the Nobel Prize in medicine, he also won the Nobel Peace Prize?

The weird look on Lin Fan’s face grew even more intense.

“Alright.”

After that, they chatted for a while more before hanging up.

Lin Fan looked at everyone in the office and said, “The president of the Nobel Peace Prize Committee called and said that I won the Peace Prize.”

Silence.

The entire office fell silent again.

Hao Zhiwu, Liu Qianqian, Nie Zhenjiang, and the others had thought that Lin Fan might win the Nobel Prize in medicine, physics, or chemistry…

However, they had never thought that Lin Fan would win the Nobel Peace Prize.

When Lin Fan said that, everyone was completely taken aback.

Hao Zhiwu’s ability to accept things seemed to be far better than others.

He was the first to react and shouted, “F*ck! Four! Professor Lin won four Nobel Prizes! Awesome, too awesome!”

The others finally came back to their senses.

“The Nobel Peace Prize. That’s right. Professor Lin invented the earthquake prediction device, which detected the earthquake in advance and saved countless people. He deserves the Nobel Peace Prize!”

“A single person has won four Nobel Prizes. This is absolutely unprecedented!”

“How is it unprecedented? In the future, there’ll never be someone like that again!”

“Oh my god, I’m actually the student of a professor with four Nobel Prizes. Am I dreaming?”

“This is awesome!”

…

Even if everyone shouted until their voices broke, even if their throats hurt…

They did not care about any of it.

They were too excited.

After Hao Zhiwu finished shouting, his gaze fell on Lin Fan and his phone.

He muttered, “I wonder if the chairman of the Nobel Literature Committee will call.”

When Lin Fan heard this, his lips twitched.

A call from the Nobel Literature Committee’s president?

‘Do you want me to win another Nobel Prize in Literature?’

A single person monopolizing all the Nobel Prizes this year?

It seemed pretty good.

Unfortunately, Lin Fan had never published any literature. Naturally, he could not win the Nobel Prize in Literature.

…

On Weibo.

The trending searches included a certain celebrity’s divorce, some common knowledge about life, the plot of a certain TV show, and so on.

These sorts of hot trending searches appeared all year round, and many people were already used to them.

However, many people still could not help but click on the title to see what was going on.

At this moment, an unusual title appeared at the bottom of the trending searches. Every few seconds, the popularity would increase rapidly, and it would continue to rise to the top of the rankings.

[Congratulations to Professor Lin Fan for winning four Nobel Prizes!]

When everyone saw the title, they could not help but click on it.

Nation Daily: [Congratulations to Professor Lin Fan for winning four Nobel Prizes! They’re the Nobel Prize Prize for chemistry, physics, medicine, and the Nobel Peace Prize! Professor Lin Fan is the first person from Hua to win these awards!

[Ever since the Nobel Prize was established, more than one award has never been given to the same person in the same year. Professor Lin has made history! He’s absolutely deserving of it. Let us congratulate Professor Lin Fan!

[Let’s review Professor Lin’s academic achievements.]

[in the field of mathematics, Professor Lin solved Zhou’s Conjecture, the Twin Prime Number Conjecture, Hail’s Conjecture, Hodge’s Conjecture, and Riemann’s Hypothesis… It’s worth mentioning that the Fields Medal is known as the Nobel Prize in mathematics! It’s the highest honor in the mathematics world! He’s the emperor of mathematics!

[In the field of computers, Professor Lin invented the carbon-based photolithographic machine and carbon-based chips. They improved the performance of the phone by leaps and bounds, allowing us to enter the game world. He’s the creator of the AI Chip!]

[In the field of chemistry, Professor Lin invented two types of super batteries and other chemical batteries. As a result, the endurance of mobile phones and new energy vehicles has undergone earth-shaking changes. Not only have they made our lives more convenient, but they’ve also greatly reduced exhaust gases. He’s the guardian of Earth!

[In the field of physics, Professor Lin invented the earthquake prediction device. This invention can detect earthquakes five days before they happen, giving us better protection against nature. He’s the guardian of humanity!

[In the medical field, Professor Lin developed the human islet recovery drug. Diabetes is one of the top ten diseases in the world! According to statistics, there are more than 100 million people with diabetes in our country alone! Countless people are tortured by diabetes, but the drug is very effective in treating diabetes. He’s an angel who saves lives!]

[As for peace, the earthquake prediction device invented by Professor Lin prevented countless people from suffering from a natural disaster. He’s the symbol of peace!]

…
